title: Soldier and Bananas
statementMd:
A soldier wants to buy $*w*$ bananas in the shop. He has to pay $*k*$ dollars for the first banana, $2*k*$ dollars for the second one and so on (in other words, he has to pay $*i*·*k*$ dollars for the $*i*$-th banana).

He has $*n*$ dollars. How many dollars does he have to borrow from his friend soldier to buy $*w*$ bananas?

## Input

The first line contains three positive integers $*k*, *n*, *w*$ ($1  ≤  *k*, *w*  ≤  1000$, $0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$), the cost of the first banana, initial number of dollars the soldier has and number of bananas he wants.

## Output

Output one integer — the amount of dollars that the soldier must borrow from his friend. If he doesn't have to borrow money, output $0$.
statementZhMd:
士兵想在商店里购买 $*w*$ 根香蕉。他必须为第一根香蕉支付 $*k*$ 美元，为第二根香蕉支付 $2*k*$ 美元，以此类推（换句话说，第 $*i*$ 根香蕉需要支付 $*i*·*k*$ 美元）。

他有 $*n*$ 美元。为了购买 $*w*$ 根香蕉，他需要向他的士兵朋友借多少钱？

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个正整数 $*k*, *n*, *w*$（$1  ≤  *k*, *w* ≤  1000$，$0 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$），分别表示第一根香蕉的价格、士兵拥有的初始美元数以及他想购买的香蕉数量。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即士兵必须向朋友借的美元数。如果他不需要借钱，输出 $0$。
